message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to building a well‑rounded leg routine—whether you’re a beginner, intermediate, or advanced lifter.  
Feel free to mix and match based on your goals (strength, hypertrophy, endurance, mobility) and the equipment you have.

---

## 1️⃣ Compound Movements (Big Movers)

| Exercise | Primary Muscles | Variations | Typical Sets/Reps |
|----------|-----------------|------------|-------------------|
| **Back Squat** | Quadriceps, glutes, hamstrings, core | Front squat, Zercher squat, goblet squat | 3–5 × 4–12 |
| **Deadlift** | Hamstrings, glutes, lower back, traps | Conventional, sumo, Romanian, stiff‑leg | 3–5 × 4–10 |
| **Leg Press** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | Narrow stance, wide stance, single‑leg | 3–4 × 8–15 |
| **Bulgarian Split Squat** | Quads, glutes, hamstrings | With barbell, dumbbells, or bodyweight | 3–4 × 6–12 |
| **Step‑Up / Box Jump** | Quads, glutes, calves | Plyometric, weighted | 3–4 × 8–15 |

> **Tip:** Keep your core tight and maintain a neutral spine. Use a weight that allows you to finish the last rep with effort but without compromising form.

---

## 2️⃣ Isolation & Mobility Work

| Exercise | Primary Muscles | Typical Sets/Reps |
|----------|-----------------|-------------------|
| **Hamstring Curl** (lying or seated) | Hamstrings | 3–4 × 10–15 |
| **Calf Raise** (standing or seated) | Calves | 4–5 × 12–20 |
| **Glute Bridge / Hip Thrust** | Glutes, hamstrings | 3–4 × 8–15 |
| **Lateral Band Walks** | Glute medius | 3–4 × 15–20 steps |
| **Hip Flexor Stretch** | Hip flexors | Hold 30–60 s × 2–3 |
| **Foam Rolling** | Entire posterior chain | 1–2 min per muscle group |

> **Pro:** These help correct imbalances, improve joint health, and enhance overall performance.

---

## 3️⃣ Sample Weekly Split

| Day | Focus | Example Routine |
|-----|-------|-----------------|
| **Mon – Lower Body Strength** | Heavy squats & deadlifts | 5 × 5 Back Squat, 4 × 6 Deadlift, 3 × 10 Leg Press |
| **Tue – Upper Body** | Push/Pull/Shoulders | (Your choice) |
| **Wed – Lower Body Hypertrophy** | Moderate load, higher volume | 4 × 8 Front Squat, 3 × 12 Bulgarian Split Squat, 3 × 15 Calf Raise |
| **Thu – Rest / Active Recovery** | Light cardio, mobility | 20 min brisk walk + foam roll |
| **Fri – Power / Plyometrics** | Explosive work | 4 × 5 Box Jump, 3 × 8 Power Clean (light), 3 × 12 Walking Lunge |
| **Sat – Full‑Body Conditioning** | Circuit style | 3 rounds: 10 Goblet Squat, 10 Push‑up, 10 Kettlebell Swing, 10 Burpee |
| **Sun – Rest** | Full recovery | Stretch, hydrate, sleep |

> **Adjust** the volume and intensity based on how you feel. If you’re new, start with 3–4 sets of 8–12 reps for most exercises.

---

## 4️⃣ Progression & Safety

| Stage | How to Progress | Key Safety Check |
|-------|-----------------|------------------|
| **Beginner** | Add 5–10 lb each week | Keep form strict; use a spotter if needed |
| **Intermediate** | Increase reps or add a set | Monitor knee alignment; avoid excessive forward lean |
| **Advanced** | Add weight, reduce rest, or incorporate supersets | Use a weight belt if lifting > 90% 1RM; ensure adequate warm‑up |

> **Common Mistakes to Avoid**  
> • Letting knees collapse inward during squats or lunges.  
> • Over‑arching the lower back during deadlifts.  
> • Neglecting calf and hip flexor mobility, which can limit range of motion.

---

## 5️⃣ Quick Warm‑Up Routine (5–7 min)

1. **Dynamic Hip Circles** – 10 each side  
2. **Bodyweight Squats** – 15 reps  
3. **Walking Lunges** – 10 each leg  
4. **Leg Swings** – 10 each leg (front‑to‑back)  
5. **Ankle Mobility Drills** – 10 each ankle  

> **Why it matters:** A proper warm‑up increases blood flow, improves joint lubrication, and primes the nervous system for heavier lifts.

---

### Final Thought

Leg training is often the most rewarding part of a program because it builds functional strength, boosts metabolism, and enhances athletic performance. Stick to a balanced mix of compound lifts, isolation work, and mobility drills, and you’ll see consistent gains while keeping injury risk low.

Happy lifting!
